name: Delinea Secret Server PAM Provider
description: The Delinea Secret Server PAM Provider allows for the retrieval of stored account credentials from a Delinea Secret Server secret. A valid username, password and secret share settings are required.

Parameters.Name: Host
Parameters.Description: The URL to the Secret Server instance. Example: https://example.secretservercloud.com/SecretServer

Parameters.Name: Username
Parameters.Description: The username used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `password` grant type.

Parameters.Name: Password
Parameters.Description: The password used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `password` grant type.

Parameters.Name: ClientId
Parameters.Description: The client ID used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `client_credentials` grant type.

Parameters.Name: ClientSecret
Parameters.Description: The client secret used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. NOTE: only applicable if using the `client_credentials` grant type.

Parameters.Name: GrantType
Parameters.Description: The grant type used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance. Valid values are `password`, `client_credentials`, or `windows`. Default is `password`. If not provided the default value `password` will be used to maintain backwards compatibility.

Parameters.Name: SecretId
Parameters.Description: The ID of the secret in Secret Server. This is the integer ID that is used to retrieve the secret from Secret Server.

Parameters.Name: SecretFieldName
Parameters.Description: The name of the field in the secret that contains the credential value. NOTE: The field must exist.

Parameters.Name: Host
Parameters.Description: The URL to the Secret Server instance. Example: https://example.secretservercloud.com/SecretServer

Parameters.Name: Username
Parameters.Description: The username used to authenticate to the Secret Server instance.

Parameters.Name: Password
